description: This file defines the BookExportService class, a Spring service component that provides book data export functionality for a specific user within the book project. It interacts with the BookRepository to retrieve books associated with a user and returns them encapsulated in an ExportDto.

classes.name: BookExportService
classes.description: Service class providing book data export functionality for a user.

methods.name: exportBooksData
methods.description: Exports a list of books associated with the provided user, returning them wrapped in an ExportDto.
